bone.$description: Bone — Page canvas, the only background tone — a warm off-white that keeps the page from feeling clinical

carbon.$description: Carbon — Primary text, project titles, navigation links, all body copy — the only ink the system ever uses

ash.$description: Ash — Secondary text, near-identical to Carbon for AAA contrast on Bone — exists for accessibility, not visual contrast

stone.$description: Stone — Muted UI surface for disabled controls, low-emphasis panels, and placeholder blocks. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

degular.$description: Sole typeface for all text — display, body, navigation, and labels. Weight 300 carries display and project titles (the 'whisper' that makes a 50px headline feel editorial, not aggressive). Weight 400 is reserved for body copy, category labels, and nav. Only two weights in the entire system, which is itself a signature choice — there is no 'bold' to reach for.
